# Evidence-first

Shared default pack, deliberately shaped to QUALIFY as proven-loop evidence
(version ≥ 2, and it cites a promoted learning) so that its exclusion from the
P3 gate is a tested guarantee rather than an untested claim. Every role gets
this pack, so it must never move a band.
